versification: R. H. Charles source numbering normalized to logical chapters 1-108 and contiguous integer verses; lettered subverses and parallel E/G^g readings are preserved in merged text/source_parts

verses.text_en: And other forms I saw hidden in that place.
verses.text_hr: Na tome sam mjestu vidio i druge skrivene oblike.

verses.text_en: I heard the voice of the angel saying: ‘These are the angels who descended to the earth, and revealed what was hidden to the children of men, and seduced the children of men into committing sin.’
verses.text_hr: Čuo sam glas anđela kako govori: „To su anđeli koji su sišli na zemlju, otkrili sinovima ljudskim ono što je bilo skriveno i zaveli sinove ljudske da počine grijeh.“
